_comment: All sources re-verified live on 2026-09-22 via fetch_page/web_search. Each entry has url + what it verifies. Dead/redirected links from earlier builds were replaced or removed (see irregularities_flagged).

stokastic_official.verifies: Homepage: 'Accurate fantasy projections, industry-leading ownership, and powerful simulations'; tool list (DataHub, Contest Generator, Pre-Contest Simulator, Late Swap, Single Lineup Simulator, Post-Contest Simulator) linking to tools.stokastic.com

All-Access pricing (list: Core $329.95, Max $449.95, MVP $849.95; with Stokastic-avatar discount: $229.95/$349.95/$599.95); contest-level sim uniqueness claim; DFS Sim definition; avatar discount explained

Sims simulate the contest 'tens of thousands of times', correlations hold (QB big game drags receivers), lineups ranked by simulated ROI vs real payout structure, optimizer-vs-sims framing, late swap re-rank, 2026 NFL pricing

Sims simulate every game play-by-play with QB-to-pass-catcher correlation baked in; Contest Sims rank lineups by simulated ROI across 'tens of thousands of simulated contests'; Steve Buzzard Milly Maker $1M win workflow
Implied team total math: total/2 + spread/2 to favorite, - spread/2 to underdog (worked example 44 total, -7 => 25.5 / 18.5)

stokastic_strategy.verifies: Cash vs GPP opposite builds; balance projection vs ownership; correlation is the engine; leverage off chalk; ~85% of entry fees paid out; EV link
Projection is the middle of a range not a promise; ceiling 75th pct, floor 25th pct, Boom% chance to smash, Bust% chance to tank, StdDev
Boom defined as ~5x(salary/1000)+10 FP; Bust = failing to clear 5x(salary/1000); ceiling 75th, floor 25th; cash vs GPP opposite shapes

Ownership = forecast of % of tournament entries rostering a player (forecast of opponents' behavior); chalk follows Vegas O/U, implied run totals, ballpark, pitching matchups; stay within 10-15 pts of max projection

Minutes come first ('no minutes, no production'); usage = share of possessions a player finishes; Pts/$ = FP / Salary x 1000; Value = FP - (Salary/1000 x 5); same-day injury news is biggest edge; FanDuel flatter scoring

DataHub columns Name/Team/Salary/Position/Order/Projected FP/Value/Projected Ownership; Sims metrics (Optimal, Leverage, Ceiling, Floor, StdDev); Top Stacks scores whole teams with stack total, stack ownership, optimal%
Late swap = one of biggest edges in NBA; NBA target top ~20% of lineups by projection but only need to beat ~30% of field on ownership

20-min daily workflow; tool list (Projections, Ownership, Contest Sims, Single Lineup Sim = ROI/cash rate/win%, Top Stacks, Late Swap, Post-Contest Sims); contest archetype + percent-to-first settings
EV = score relative to the field (not raw score); Sims rank lineups by simulated ROI and win probability; leverage only +EV at equal-ish projection
Ownership projections sortable so heaviest concentrations float to top; leverage = gap between player's upside and projected ownership

oddsshopper.verifies: Projection system is not a rating built off last season's box scores; runs high-level simulations many times; X-Win / X-ROI / HOLD metrics; projections from Alex Baker, #1 DFS player
Props built bottom-up from player data and simulation, priced against 15+ sportsbooks; tune inputs; blend or override; injury-aware
Four-step process (project -> price fair odds -> shop best line -> size to edge) and devig math
Custom NBA projections: edit minutes/rates, blend slider between 100% your model and model/market blend; a projection is a distribution not a single number

Official DraftKings NBA scoring (pt 1, 3PM +0.5, reb 1.25, ast 1.5, stl 2, blk 2, TO -0.5, DD 1.5, TD 3) and $50,000 cap

Minutes method: 240 total team minutes; baseline = season_avg*0.75 + last5_avg*0.25; blowout scale spread>=7 reduce 1.5% per point
Third-party NBA daily projections board with DK/FD salary, value, floor, ceiling, ownership columns (industry reference)
